## Boss Rules Checklist

- [ ] **Design-First (Rule #1)**: Design doc created and approved for features >200 LOC
- [ ] **LEGO features (Rule #3)**: new model/service/UI/wire components properly separated
- [ ] **No hard-coding (Rule #8)**: Configuration externalized, no redundancy introduced
- [ ] **CI passes**: lint, budget, design-doc-check, tests, coverage
- [ ] **CODEOWNERS review**: requested for guarded paths (/wire/, /buses/, /designs/)
